Container.Name: Budgero
Container.Overview:
Budgero is a source-available, end-to-end encrypted zero-based budgeting app in the YNAB mold — manual-first entry with rule-based automation, multi-currency support, and YNAB/CSV import. Ships as a single Go binary with SQLite storage and typically runs in under 200MB RAM.
IMPORTANT: set "Allowed sync origins" to the exact origin you open the app from (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3001 or https://budget.example.com). The sync WebSocket rejects connections from any other origin and the budget will not load. Exact match on scheme/host/port, no wildcards.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Budgero web UI and sync WebSocket.

Config.Name: Allowed sync origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to connect to sync, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3001. Required for any non-localhost access — use the exact scheme, host and port you open the app with. No wildcards.
